facts.fact: MyBroadband reports SA Connect, launched by government in 2013 through Broadband Infraco and SITA, plans 1,180 km of further fibre in Phase 2 to cover about 5.5 million households, with rollout limited by Infraco's finances; its CEO named it and the Broadband Access Fund as key projects in February 2025.

MyBroadband reports Broadband Infraco's network covers all nine provinces of South Africa and extends to neighbouring borders, with 15,000 km of fibre and 156 points of presence per its corporate profile.
MyBroadband reports Broadband Infraco's licence lets it sell high-capacity long-distance transmission services to licensed fixed and mobile operators and internet service providers.

ZAF.note: Load-shedding isolating points of presence is mentioned with no outage count.
SITA named only as SA Connect partner; no system it runs or builds is stated.
Network said to reach neighbours' borders; no named cross-border link or agreement.
